method: original v12 FUSION790; evaluated p=3,p=4 before p=4 was chosen; no training or calibration in this run
source_scope: Three existing captures; password-associated Zeek connections, not independent password attempts.
owner_source: Moustafa et al., Data Analytics-enabled Intrusion Detection, Figure 2 and section III (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2010.08521); original project topology DOI 10.1016/j.scs.2021.102994.
answer: Main requires independent cross-file identity. Supplemental permits the same documented logical role at its fixed IP. No other changes.
normal_rule: All inbound normal_2 packets of a matched target/protocol; reset v12 namespace at each original file. A single append-order Wireshark stream pass identifies continuations from normal_1; include once and report separately.
reference: Earliest continuous same-target normal_1 segment covering a real 7200 seconds. Use the frozen B2 anchors and component-balanced dense 4096 cap per device/protocol. No additional earlier independent history is registered.
eligibility: Unique protected endpoint in original frame and v12 causal/header admissibility. IP source and destination bind owner direction in SLL; no Ethernet destination MAC is manufactured.
metrics: Per target, seed and ensemble, all/off-bypass/off-bypass with data. A=RAW positive attack queries in the paired layer, B=count of those with s>0, W=count of those actually withdrawn; verify W<=B<=A. Rates (A-W)/A and W/B; zero denominator NA. Unpaired groups have all CCNR numerators and rates explicitly rendered as 未评价 (NOT_EVALUATED).
